articleTitle: On the Arrival Curves Calculation for Facilities of Increased Danger
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: For present-day facilities of increased danger, such time-related performance measures as delays in control actions transmission and emergency signals presentation are critical. Taking into consideration the appropriate control systems, one can note that the knowledge of arrival processes is necessary for the assessment of such delays. A couple of significant branches of applied mathematics: queueing theory and a theory of deterministic queuing systems network calculus operate with arrival processes and can help with delay evaluation. Arrival curves, a representation of arrival processes in network calculus, seem to be much easier to handle and obtain than probability distributions used in queueing theory. Nevertheless, many different arrival curves can be distinguished, each of them having its pros and cons. The article considers the problem of arrival curve representation and calculation for facilities of increased danger. It discloses the duality of the concept of arrival curve and investigates different types of them: the classical minimal arrival curve, the empirical one, linear arrival curves based on the empirical ones, and arrival curves on finite intervals. For the empirical arrival curve, the algorithm is presented, and the drawbacks are revealed. The advantages and disadvantages of empirical-based linear arrival curves are pointed out. The concept of arrival curves on finite intervals is considered, and the linear representation of them is highlighted. The algorithm for the calculation of linear arrival curves on finite intervals is presented, and their advantages are discussed.

articleTitle: The Application of Digital Twins of the Subsystems of APCS of NPP at the Stage of Factory Tests
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The task of executing factory tests of the subsystems, including in the Automated process control system (APCS) of a Nuclear power plant (NPP), in the absence of actual related subsystems, is considered. The methods for solving this problem using software and hardware modeling tools (digital twins) for the subsystems of upper and lower levels of APCS of NPP are proposed.

Author Keywords: subsystems of upper and lower levels

articleTitle: Scenario Approach to Countering Mail Phishing Attacks in the Business Sphere
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper presents an interdisciplinary research in cybersecurity, examining the impact of employees’ behavioral factors on vulnerability to phishing attacks by email, using various scenarios. The research considers the psychological traits of employees in different departments of a company and assesses their influence on susceptibility to phishing attacks. The author proposes an approach that allows companies to develop more effective counter-phishing strategies. This approach helps identify unique psychological and behavioral patterns that can serve as risk factors in the context of phishing attacks.

articleTitle: Critical Phenomena in the Darrieus Wind Turbine Model
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses a mathematical model of a small wind turbine with a vertical axis, the so-called Darrieus wind turbine. It examines the existence, stability, and optimization of steady-state regimes. The article shows that, there is a critical value of the parameter characterizing external resistance.

articleTitle: Multicriteria Data Processing Management in the Geographically Distributed Computing Systems with QoS Time Requirements
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the problem of data processing management in fog- and edge-computing environments. The main issue of task planning is that the environments of the fog and edge network tiers are dynamic and heterogeneous in terms of optimization criteria. Previously published papers do not consider the heterogeneity of the criteria in the tasks of data processing, although the heterogeneity of the network generates a wide range of criteria and constraints for the workload distribution. The main contribution of this paper is as follows: the general model of a multicriteria workload distribution problem, which differs from previously proposed ones by the heterogeneous criteria usage, and by the integration of the reconfiguration process into the problem description, taking into account the main QoS time constraint. The basic method of the problem solution is proposed, too, with paying attention to the data transit extra-costs. Some selected simulation examples are described as well, which present the possibility to achieve the solution of the problem formulated.

articleTitle: Fundamental Scientific Discipline "Identification of Systems" and Fundamental Education
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We discussed the general characteristics of the fundamental scientific discipline "System Identification". Based on the ideas of this discipline, we propose it to create a fundamental training course "System Identification", which considers the specifics of professional activities of Moscow Engineering Physics Institute (MEPhI) graduates in the nuclear industry. The scientific reflection of this specificity in identification methods is a difficult scientific problem. To solve this problem, we need new fundamental and applied research to develop and concretize the fundamental provisions of the scientific discipline in relation to the real conditions for identifying objects with an increased risk of exploitation. To perform effective research and design work, we proposed it to perform extensive informatization of identification processes at the stages of pre-project research and the design of automated and automated systems.

articleTitle: A New Approach to the Application of Automatic Control Methods to Signalized Intersections of Urban Roads
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The prerequisites for the use of automatic control methods for traffic light regulation of the intersection with constant monitoring of the local traffic flow are analyzed. A set of possible controlled indicators of local traffic is defined. The methodology and results of computer experiments to identify the most efficient methods of traffic regulation are presented.

articleTitle: The Development of Regions in a Conflict: the Background and the Activity of Authorities
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Using a "passive experiment" a study of the self-organization of the regions of the Siberian Federal District of Russia was carried out. A bifurcation of the dependence of the average per capita monetary income of the region’s population on the value of a specific region’s gross domestic product in the process of evolution has been revealed. A sharp slowdown (almost twofold) in the course of this dependence in the process of evolution after 2014 (after Crimea joined to Russia) revealed.

articleTitle: Equilibrium in Open Market Models with Nonconstant Elastisities
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers an open market model, where the elasticities are power functions of the price. We obtain sufficient conditions on equilibrium existence for this model and illustrate it with a numerical experiment.

articleTitle: Investment Planning in the Region
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The principle of multiplicity is introduced for the components of the investment planning process. Some algorithms are given that ensure the process of investment planning at the regional level: the formation of integrated assessments of investment projects, automated generation of projects, multicriteria evaluation and selection of projects, taking into account the mutual influence of projects, optimizing the composition of projects, and taking into account financing restrictions. The features of the program system intended for the formation of plans for the territorial and sectoral development of the region are considered.

articleTitle: The Effect of Internet Shutdowns on Protest Activity in India: an Empirical Investigation
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The role of the Internet as a factor of collective action is now widely recognized in the literature. Social media coverage and, more generally, Internet coverage received significant research attention and have been used to explain various phenomena. However, the effect of Internet regulation policies on collective action is a much less understood subject. We investigate the effects of Internet shutdowns on protest activity in India. We describe several empirical strategies and show how statistical estimates of shutdown effects differ across these strategies. We also propose several modifications to our strategies with the goal of improving the model quality in the future.

articleTitle: Convergent Approach in Evaluating the Effectiveness of Large-Scale IT Department Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Convergent technologies are beginning to manifest themselves as the main directions of development, while numerous studies emphasize the potential advantages associated with introducing these technologies. One of the main advantages of convergent technologies in managing large-scale information systems is to improve the quality of their planning and management.

articleTitle: Study of the Continuous-Time Open Dynamic Leontief Model as a Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: V.V. Leontief’s open dynamic model with continuous time is considered as a linear dynamic system with control. In the model under study, the function of non-productive consumption serves as control. The necessary conditions for the closure of the technological set are obtained.

articleTitle: Development Trends of Web Browser and Service Browser Clients in Large-Scale Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The issue of certain types of clients for large-scale systems is being considered. Hardware and software devices based on web browsers and service browsers are defined as the main clients. A comparison of their capabilities, an analysis of the use of such devices, and development trends are carried out.

articleTitle: Estimates of the Stress State of Venus’s Interior
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An assessment of nonhydrostatic stresses in the interior of Venus was carried out for various models of inhomogeneous elasticity: the elastic model and models with a lithosphere of different thickness. We use data from the topography and gravitational field of the planet as boundary conditions. Numerical modeling of the system of equations of elastic equilibrium of a gravitating planet was carried out with a step of 1x1 degrees in latitude and longitude to a depth of 480 km.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Approximations of a Regulator and a Convergent Iteration Process for a Singularly Perturbed Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the construction of asymptotic expansions in a singularly perturbed weakly nonlinear control problem to design an approximate controller. The asymptotic expansions are used to construct interpolation and extrapolation procedures and are obtained by applying the SDRE technique and analyzing a convergent iterative process. The experiments performed showed the efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Problems in Applying Machine Learning Methods to Aviation
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report discusses potential applications of machine learning methods in aviation. Problems hindering the rapid implementation of machine learning methods in aviation, such as adversarial attacks, problems of data shift and data leakage, and the opacity of black box models, are investigated.

articleTitle: The Principle of ‘Distributed Management’
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report examines the principle of distributed control proposed by the author as a measure of expansion of the target model – Tinbergen tools. The purpose of the study is to determine the very principle of ‘distributed management,’ the circumstances of the emergence of the so-called ‘cumulative effect’ of economic policy. The methodological basis is the theory of management of large-scale systems and the theory of economic policy of Tinbergen. Its application allows us to show that, since the instruments of macroeconomic management over time, due to various circumstances, change the strength of their impact in the direction of the development goal, it is necessary, on the one hand, to practice a differentiated approach in management – ‘distributed management,’ on the other hand – to expand classical methods, in particular the principle of ‘goals - Tinbergen's tools. In this variant, this principle is absent in a large class of economic policy models and growth models. The first presupposes the accounting of instruments, without factor conditions. The second, on the contrary, focuses on growth factors, not including, in fact, instruments of influence. The result of the study is an extension of the Tinbergen principle due to the principle of distributed management, which allows the measurement of various options for economic development policy for an extensive-scale system. Introduction

Author Keywords: models of economic policy and growth

articleTitle: Modeling Denial-of-Service Attacks Protection Controller Using Network Calculus
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: "Denial of Service" attack is a severe problem that must be solved by maintaining the availability properties in the digital networked system. In particular, this may be due to various types of flow restriction systems (Shapers or Policy enforcement devices). Limiting the input stream allows to ensure stable network operation without long delays and overloading the processing data components. The device or controller limits the amount of data passed through, and in such a way, it protects the system from flood attacks, expected to overflow the network channel. However, such systems must have the relevant characteristics, including the extreme conditions during attacks on the system. The proposed model makes it possible to calculate the characteristics of a controller that maintains the limitation of the input flow within the given limits. The Network Calculus method is the basis of this model.

articleTitle: Models and Methods for Forecasting the Data of the Management System Flood Preparation and Elimination
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses the processes of data formation necessary for decision-making in the management system of the processes flood preparation and elimination. We have developed a model for forecasting the flood effects characteristics and have reviewed the basic measures flood prevention and response for various stages of the management system operation.

articleTitle: Application of Advanced Systems of User Identification in APCS Control Subsystems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper presents research on applying the user identification subsystem for industrial automation systems. Within the framework of this study, we propose software and hardware architecture for the analysis of the effectiveness of identification systems using the browser fingerprints, including a backend server with SQL database and software modules for the analysis and visualization of the data collected. The results of the experiment show that modern frameworks and modules can be used for user identification in industrial automation systems. However, additional verification procedures for user control and management system are required. The maximum average accuracy of user identification based on their integrated browser fingerprint increases with the total number of authorizations (up to 92-93% at the end of the experiment), with almost no new fingerprints generated.

articleTitle: Usage of Continuous Medical Monitoring in Human-Machine Systems to Improve Their Reliability and Emergency Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A method of conducting continuous medical monitoring of human operators of human-machine systems is proposed. This method assumes building a decision support system that selects the control mode of the technological process. This paper has simulation modeling results of the technological process conditions changing from a potentially faulty state to a proper state.

articleTitle: Index Fund Portfolios Efficiency on the Stock Markets of the Russia, USA, Germany and China for 2012-2022
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An analysis of the performance indicators of index investment portfolios of the Russian Federation, the USA, Germany and China stock markets for 2012-2022 was carried out. The most effective methods for optimizing index portfolios have been identified. An analysis and comparison of factors influencing the efficiency of index portfolios of various stock markets was carried out. Recommendations are proposed to improve the efficiency of index investment portfolios of the stock markets under consideration

articleTitle: Evaluation of Large-scale Transport Projects Efficiency Based on Vector Criterion
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article examines the problems associated with assessing the socio-economic efficiency of a large-scale investment project for the development of a network transport infrastructure. An approach based on a vector criterion is proposed, which takes into account the properties of difficult to structure investment projects and broads the range of information available to the decision-maker.

articleTitle: Development of a Competence Model in the Field of Information Technology Using Ontologies and Knowledge Bases
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes an approach to building a competency model for information technology. A review of the existing competency models, knowledge bases, ontologies, and automatic ontology building algorithms shows that it is essential to create a model based on an automatically supplemented ontology using structured data from general-purpose knowledge bases.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of Pneumonia Using Anderson Discriminant Function
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: we propose a simple method for diagnosing pneumonia from x-rays using Anderson discriminant function and posterior class probabilities.

articleTitle: Optimal Asset and Liability Management by a Bank under Internal and External Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This work is devoted to the study of the optimal behavior of a bank that can manage the volume of loans and deposits, and whose work is regulated both by internal restrictions and by legislation.

articleTitle: Orchestration as a Form of Ecosystem Business Model Management and Planning of their Development
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The author studied ecosystem business models and investigated the specifics of their management, the essence and the essence, purpose, and principles of orchestration of ecosystem business models as forms of their management. She also worked out the structure of the ecosystem business model, classified the control actions in them, and proposed a model of the optimal plan for developing of the business ecosystem.

articleTitle: Fitting Weights up to the Second Order in Multi-Valued Cognitive Maps. Aircraft Control Mode Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report presents an algorithm for selecting weights in a multi-valued cognitive map up to the second order. In such a map, variables (concepts and weights) are elements of a linguistic variable lattice, and there is no transition from them to numbers. This map is used to decide about the aircraft control mode. The decision results are compared with the decision using multi-valued associative memory.

articleTitle: On Efficient Planning of Oil&Gas Investments and Characteristics of BMS-models Destabilization
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: With an unconventional approach, we regard the problem of building a precise adaptive model of oil price dynamics in the context of investment projects. I. Newton formulated the principle of analysis. We list the Principles of applying the stochastic theory of asset management to building the optimal investment projects in oil and gas field development. We also analyze all the data of daily oil exchange from 1988 to 2019 (spot prices, Platts (Platt’s) McGraw Hill Financial). We use methods and quantitative evaluations of adaptive BMS models with stochastic switches. We outline precise (normalized quadratic deviation within 9%) adaptive BMS models, plot extrapolation (quasi-forecast) on a stability period; make a stability period quasi-forecast and list essential quantitative evaluations and graphs. We discuss the possibility of quick profiting using BMS models. We also discuss the approaches to solving the problem of building optimal midterm oil and gas field development projects and operations, as well as the results we acquire. Analysis of incomes and expenses of an optimal investment project would allow for a substantiated decision on whether the development should be started or forgone.

articleTitle: Application of the Method of Multivariate Multi-stage Forecasting Based on the LSTM Deep Learning Model for Bitcoin Price Time Series
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Forecasting data and research on cryptocurrency price forecasting methods are increasing in importance. So far, methods based on LSTM deep learning architecture have shown the best results in forecasting cryptocurrency prices. In order to improve the accuracy of forecasting data, this paper investigates the application of a multivariate multistep forecasting method based on the LSTM deep learning model for the bitcoin price time series and evaluates its effectiveness. The variants of multivariate multistep forecasting implementation based on deep learning LSTM are analyzed, and a direct approach for building multistep forecasts is chosen. Time series of bitcoin price and cumulative stability and drawdowns are used as input data. Based on our research, we found that short-term predictions were most accurate using models trained on trading data. However, for long-term forecasts, incorporating stability features slightly improved accuracy.

articleTitle: A Model to Support Intuitive Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A mathematical model of a decision support system aimed at stimulating the subject's intellectual activity for making intuitive-experimental decisions is considered. The model is based on semiotic mental space model built by an expert. Methods for solving the inverse problem for finding formal solutions to achieve some goal are proposed. To interpret of formal solutions, it is proposed to apply vector static (Word2Vec) and dynamic (ruBERT, ruGPT) language models obtained by training neural networks with a text corpus. Examples of formal solutions interpretation of the inverse problem with the help of the language vector models are considered, and their possibilities of stimulating the intellectual activity of the subject for making intuitive-experimental decisions are analyzed.

articleTitle: A Look at The Metrology of Synthesis of Large-Scale Systems and Their Control from the Position of a Transdisciplinary Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the application of a transdisciplinary approach, which allows to determine the place of large-scale systems in a holistic picture of the world, procedures for the synthesis of such systems, and methods for controlling them. The article highlights the key points concerning the specifics of the systems under consideration. Revealed a set of tasks, the solution of which determines the appropriate methodology. Shown the sources of a wealth of methods.

articleTitle: Forming a Comfortable Environment for Large-scale Production and Economic Systems on the Cluster Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article outlines the main provisions of the hypothesis on the feasibility of creating a comfortable environment within large-scale production and economic systems based on the cluster approach. Hypothesis assumes the basic principles of sustainable development in creating a comfortable environment for the interaction of enterprises, taking into account their innovative and industrial potential.

articleTitle: Methods for Reducing the Computational Complexity of Problems of Optimizing Data Allocation in Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An effective method of increasing the reliability of distributed data processing systems is using an operational reserve from copies of data arrays located in the nodes of the system. Problems of finding the optimal placement of the reserve in the system nodes have a high computational complexity. This article presents several methods for reducing the complexity of the tasks under consideration.

articleTitle: On Cauchy Problem for Semilinear Second-Order Parabolic Equations on Spheres
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article is devoted to solvability of the Cauchy problem for non-autonomous semilinear parabolic second-order partial differential equations on n-dimensional spheres. Such equations are non-homogeneous and non-autonomous analogs on spheres of the Kolmogorov–Petrovsky–Piskunov and Fischer equations.

articleTitle: Interval Pade Approximation for the Construction of an Approximate D-SDRE Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper a parametric family of stabilizing controllers for a nonlinear discrete control system is obtained for different values of a parameter at the system matrix. An algorithm for constructing a stabilizing controller based on the D-SDRE approach, asymptotic methods and Padé approximations is proposed which uses asymptotic expansions in the neighborhood of the boundary and interior points of the given parameter variation interval which break it on several subintervals.

articleTitle: Using Convolutional Neural Networks for Estimating the Speed and Acceleration of UAVs During Takeoff and Landing Through Multicamera Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this work, convolutional neural networks are used for multicamera detection of UAVs and estimation of their speed and acceleration during the stages of takeoff and landing. This opens up new opportunities in the field of UAV navigation and control.

articleTitle: On One Approach to the Construction of a Non-Dissipative Kinematic Dynamo on a Non-Compact Manifold
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses models of large-scale objects in which the effect of a non-dissipative kinematic dynamo takes place. A dynamo design is constructed for finite divergence-free vector fields and diffeomorphisms in n— dimensional space. The approach uses the construction of prolonging a vector field from the unit sphere to a divergence-free finite vector field in space.

articleTitle: A Purely Algebraic Method of Volatile Equilibrium Calculation for a Systems Permitting Excess Demand Agrégation
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Volatile equilibrium is a method of implementing of macroeconomic aspects like money, debt, and finance into a purely microeconomic general equilibrium Arrow model (modeling natural exchange). Here we deal with the collective consumption of a price equilibrium stability reserve as a common resource, each investor consumes roughly proportionally to its' leverage, leading to a bad equilibrium similar to the typical resource-system overloading phenomenon, when further leverage increasing isn't interesting to investors due to the risk induced by price volatility the common resource overconsumption leads to. In the article we consider mainly an algorithmic aspect of the calculation of this volatile equilibrium. The calculation of volatile equilibrium generally is algorithmically hard problem, that takes much calculational resources at no obvious parametric or qualitative analysis perspective. In the article we introduce a version of suitable for parametric analysis and theoretical investigation almost analytical method permitting to exclude any trajectory calculation.

Author Keywords: introduction of finance (and money) to Arrow model

articleTitle: Balanced Decisions Modeling in the Development of Organization Technical Policy
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The model considered describes the balance of technical solutions in the organizational network structure. The model employs the concept of the loss function. It is a function of the imbalance of indicators describing the characteristics of equipment, components, and technical infrastructure. The paper determines conditions for balance and proposes an incentive mechanism to ensure balance.

articleTitle: Econometric Modeling of the Company's Intellectual Capital in the Context of Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An approach to assessing the value of intellectual capital has been developed. Models demonstrating the impact of intellectual capital and its components on the financial performance of companies implementing a digital transformation strategy have been constructed. The influence of R&D investments on company performance has been evaluated, and strategic modeling of enterprise revenue growth rates has been conducted.

articleTitle: The Impact of Errors in Business Processes on the Operability of Engineering Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Typical errors in modern enterprise business processes arisе from incorrect construction of business operation sequences. The impact of errors in business processes on the performance of the engineering infrastructure is studied. The problem complexity requires the creation of a business processes integrated model and technical object models. The paper considers the principles of creation and features of the presented model.

articleTitle: Internet Representation of Research Institutions as a Result of Science Reform
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the condition and comparison of representation on the Internet of both unaffected and reformed research institutions, in order to form a methodology for assessing the possibility of adequate and timely response to the enormous social and economic challenges occurring in the world; for this purpose, websites' content condition and dynamics are analyzed using the example of agricultural research institutions based on monitoring thereof in 2017 and 2022. It is shown that the science reform proved itself inconsistent since at first it did not respond to the demands of production during the pandemic, and now to the requests due to sanctions. The result of the science reform was a significant increase in the number of uninformative websites, which contradicts the new social order that all sectors of society, business, and management generate for digital tools for transferring scientific developments to the economy against the backdrop of severe sanctions and the pandemic.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Quality of Robust PCA versions in the Reducion of datasets with Outliers
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers PCA modifications based on robust estimates of correlation matrices of observed multivariate correlated indicators. Based on simulated and real socio-economic data, the robust versions of the PCA were compared with the traditional version. A higher quality of robust PCA is demonstrated when observations contain outliers or have heavy-tailed distributions.

Author Keywords: robust estimates of the correlation matrix

articleTitle: The Impact of Online Social Network Algorithms on User Opinion Formation
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We examine a model that focuses on forming an information cascade of user comments on a post within an online social network. These comments exhibit various attitudes toward a specific issue and can be categorized as positive, negative, or neutral. The probability of a user composing a comment with a particular attitude is influenced by their initial opinion and the collection of previously posted comments they encounter. The arrangement of these comments in a specific order is determined by the social network's algorithm. Through simulation modeling, this study investigates the impact of the algorithm on the properties of the resulting information cascade.

articleTitle: Influence of the Sequence of Drilling Fields on the Maximum Total Gas Production
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We analyze an aggregated dynamic model for the development of gas fields. The same company consistently drills all fields. We pose and solve the problem of maximizing accumulated gas production over a predetermined period of time.

Author Keywords: aggregated dynamic model of gas field development
sequence of drilling of fields in development
and procedure of numerical search for the maximum solution

articleTitle: Investigation of Hybrid DEA Models in Conditions of Changing Economies of Scale
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The application of DEA technologies is considered in the interests of studying the complex structure of risks in modeling the dynamics of crisis situations and the complex improvement of providing algorithms for strategic management and operational management in modern conditions. The scale effect is studied together with the specifics of hybrid models that correspond to the joint monitoring problem.

articleTitle: Models of Battle Dynamics in Strategic Computer Games
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A set of new models that describe the dynamics of battles in strategic computer games is presented. These models not only have descriptive functions, but also allow solving problems of optimizing army control under given conditions, as well as calculating the most efficient composition of the army for the planned operation within a computer game.

articleTitle: Situational Operational Planning in Real-time Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The scheduling problem is considered for the case when requests for the execution of job complexes with known characteristics receive at given times. Interrupts and switching from one executive mechanism to another are allowed. The composition of all complexes and the characteristics of jobs become known only at the time of each request. It is required to determine whether there is an admissible schedule for the total set of jobs and build it in case of a positive answer. We have developed a polynomial algorithm for solving the problem. The algorithm is based on constructing a network flow model and searching for the maximum flow. The problem of constructing an admissible schedule for jobs with non-fixed durations is studied. We have developed a method for preliminary (before the experiment in real-time) calculation of schedules, the computational complexity of which is significantly less than the computational complexity of a complete enumeration of all possible duration vectors.

articleTitle: Software of the "Alice" Type for the Multi-Agent System of Monitoring the Problems of the Development of the Car Service Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: the paper considers the problems of organizing of monitoring the service and maintenance infrastructure of the transport industries with an illustration on the example of the auto service industry. The article proposes the principles of systematization of information for a multi-agent monitoring system and information services for the industry, focused on digitalization and voice assistant technology.

articleTitle: Comparison of Efficiency of Feature Extraction Methods in the Early Diagnostics of Technical Objects Using Methods of Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report discusses the problem of early diagnosis and classification of the technical condition of the aircraft assembly. The main purpose of the report is to compare the types of methods for analyzing vibration signals - the Fast Fourier Transform and the family of wavelet transformations - to assess their effectiveness in solving the problem of classifying the technical condition of the helicopter gearbox.

articleTitle: Application of the Semantic Segmentation Method in the Assessment of Forest Carbon Balance
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article focuses on the problem of human impact on the natural environment and its solution by machine learning methods. The concept of carbon balance is key in assessing climate change on the planet, which is especially important in connection with global warming. The main causes of global warming are associated with anthropogenic emissions of carbon dioxide as a result of agricultural production, land use and burning of fossil fuels. One of the approaches to mitigate this environmental problem is to estimate the carbon balance based on neural network semantic segmentation of forests of terrestrial ecosystems. The proposed convolutional neural network (CNN) model is based on the U-Net architecture. This architecture surpasses traditional machine learning methods in solving computer vision and pattern recognition problems, and is also quite easy to learn. The input data of the model is a set of satellite images of the forest area. The images were obtained using the Sentinel-2 satellite, which provides high spatial resolution and a large number of spectral channels. A software prototype has been developed to implement the CNN model. Training experiments and calculations on changes in the carbon balance in forests led to the conclusion that the results of the study will contribute to the balanced management of reforestation and carbon deposition.

articleTitle: Management Model of Diversified Scientific and Technological Projects in the High-tech Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The specific structure of applied research programs and tasks of selecting technological alternatives is substantiated, within the framework of which a step-by-step selection of alternatives among technologies within one functional group or among product designs satisfying the supersystem requirements is made. The general formulation of management tasks of diversified technology development projects is stated.

articleTitle: Approach to Designing a Construction of Typical Main Landing Gear Brackets of an Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The design of the main landing gears meets the requirements of the Federal aviation regulations. One of the requirements is to prevent the transfer of dangerous loads during emergency landing. To do this, weak links are used in the landing gear design. The calculation of the weak link’s strength can be considered to be a static task as well as a dynamic one.

articleTitle: Approaches to Diagnostics of Natural-monopoly Properties of Extra-urban Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Model approaches are proposed, and computational procedures for assessing technological characteristics of the network transport subsystems operation and development are elaborated, which make it possible to clarify the influence of the natural monopoly synergy effect. Calculation results are presented for various formulations of the problems of diagnosis on natural monopoly properties concerning extra-urban regional transport networks based on models of natural monopoly normative identification).

articleTitle: Development of the Comprehensive Simulation Model of a Transport Network Segment of the City
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An improved approach to the development of road network segments simulation models intended for the road infrastructure efficiency improvement and automation of the control decision-making under different scenarios of traffic flow changes, traffic lights operation parameters, and the organization traffic management as a whole is proposed. An increasing role of simulation modeling in intelligent transport systems operation is noted.

articleTitle: Identification of Refinery Distillation Column First Principles Simulation Models
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We have verified the principal possibility of identifying a first principles simulation model of a deethanizer distillation column of an oil refinery’s typical gas fractionating unit. The article analyzes the results of a series of numerical experiments on identifying this model using an extended Kalman filter.

articleTitle: Investor Risk Profile Determination Model
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An assessment of the investor’s risk profile is proposed as a risk coefficient in a model with a linear convolution of expected return and variance. The value of the risk coefficient is found from solving the optimization problem of the model with a limitation on profitability. The proposed method is implemented in the form of a software package using the example of the stock market.

articleTitle: Decision Support Model and Methods for the Analysis of the Consequences of Atmospheric Emissions of Chemically Hazardous Substances at an Oil Refinery
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A model for decision-making in the management of an oil refining enterprise has been proposed and justified, allowing one to analyze the consequences of atmospheric emissions and recommend actions to reduce damage.

articleTitle: Planning the Operations of a Group of Autonomous Unmanned Underwater Vehicles Based on a Carrier Vessel as a Solution for Multiple Traveling Salesmen Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We propose a method for calculating the work carried out as part of the monitoring of a river or water basin. A group of autonomous crewless underwater vehicles (AUVs), accompanied by a base ship, do the job based on a two-level model. Examples of monitoring are given for arbitrarily located inspection points using the mathematical apparatus of the of multiple traveling salesmen problem.

articleTitle: Aggregation Behavior of Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem is considered to ensure sufficient alignment of the courses of all robots in a flock while maintaining a safe distance and without clustering. The conditions for the initial location of the robots are determined, and an algorithm for flocking control is proposed, taking into account the restrictions on maneuvering and in conditions of limited communication (sensor range).

articleTitle: Monte Carlo-Based Algorithm for Solving Inverse Problems of Planet Interiors
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm for solving the problem of linking theoretical data extracted from the model with new information obtained by measuring some observable parameters is present. Numerical implementation of the method showed similar results to the known classic model example of inversion of gravitational field data.

articleTitle: Soft Dependencies Between Projects In Program Management
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We analyzed program management tasks in the presence of soft dependencies between projects. Implementing soft dependencies reduces the time or cost of completing the immediate next project. The article formulates a problem and provides a solution, in which it is necessary to determine a set of executable soft dependencies under various conditions.

articleTitle: Market Failures and Basic Immanent Non-material Constraints for A Conventional Economic Exchange System
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An abstract economy always faces at least material constraints. The 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> Arrow theorems give us a set of conditions under which one can ‘easily’ achieve any physically permitted Pareto-optimal distribution he needs. In reality, a big part or nearly all of these conditions are violated. Still, laissez-fair policy advocates consider such circumstances as widespread but particular exceptions, that can potentially be fixed by "appropriate institutions". Here we demonstrate a set of universal constraints (not always active) like possible labor excess, price stability constraint (with volatility generation layer as a Hardin‘s’ barrier-punishment function), and additional liquidity constraint system (unifying both material and non-physical aspect) that are a concrete and nearly unavoidable consequence of the current state of market-running mechanisms. This circumstance makes one deeply pessimistic about libertarian deregulation principles’ applicability. Here we make an effort to present these constraints in one set of variables.

articleTitle: Identifying an Oil Production Model on a Shale Well (Based on Data from the North Dakota State)
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A database was developed for month-by-month oil production and well’s oil rates for shale wells. For each oil well, the initial well’s oil rate and the oil production decline rates are identified. Oil companies can use the model for estimating residual recoverable oil reserves for a given well, according to the dynamics in the first few months of the actual well’s oil rates.

articleTitle: Development of a Predictive Multilayer Perceptron for Quality Analysis of an ERP Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article discusses the development of a neural network to analyze the quality of ERP systems. It uses a subset of 12 quality parameters defined in ISO 25010 as input parameters for the neural network, which is based on a multilayer perceptron architecture. Through a newly created reduction methodology, the connections in the neural network reduced, resulting in a high-accuracy neural network. Created neural network can simplify and speed up the process of analyzing the quality of ERP systems, and a web application developed for user interaction with neural network.

articleTitle: Optimization Models for the Synthesis of Reliable Design Solutions under Mixed Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Optimization models have been developed, in which the levels of uncertainty and probability measures were used as optimization criteria. These models were used at the stage of preliminary design of technical objects in conditions of mixed uncertainty, when non-deterministic parameters were set using both statistical and expert information.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of a Stochastic Traffic Flow through an Intersection Based on Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A method is introduced for computer modeling of traffic at a signalized intersection of urban roads treated as a random process. It is based on the use of statistical dependencies for temporal headways between subsequent vehicles. Methods for obtaining such dependences from monitoring data are considered. Examples of calculations for a T-junction are presented and analyzed.

articleTitle: The Functional Stability Ensuring Methodology of a Complex Technical System
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Violating of the functional stability of modern complex technical systems often becomes critical for the systems in whose interests they function. The paper proposes an approach to ensure the functional stability of such a system based on the use of the process approach and the law of maintaining the system’s integrity. The resulting methodology describes the functional stability ensuring the process of a complex technical system.

Author Keywords: functional stability of a complex technical system
law ensuring the intended purpose of a complex technical system
profile of the functioning of a complex technical system

articleTitle: The Impact of Professionalism on Friendly Interaction in an Online Game
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper examines the effect of player rank on player friendships in the game Heroes of the Storm. It reveals that players above the average level, but not the maximum level, are the most active. The author supposes that the findings are generalizable to other areas of activity.

articleTitle: Regression Models for Predicting the Size of Railway Track Deviations
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This study aims to develop a method for predicting the size of deviations beyond standard values in railway tracks. Despite significant progress made in the predictive maintenance of extended objects, effective adaptation of time series forecasting methods to the estimation of deviation sizes remains limited. The proposed method involves a statistical analysis of multidimensional feature space, formation of input, output, and control parameters, creation a uniform two-dimensional grid, and predicting the size of deviations in the grid nodes. The last step incorporates a linear regression model with L1 regularization, which proved to be a practical approach for prediction deviations, avoiding overfitting, and enhancing the model's generalization ability by adding a complexity penalty. The resulting model can predict the size of deviations based on a significant number of features, allowing for early detection of potential issues and timely preventive maintenance.

articleTitle: Features of Modelling the Effects of Sectoral Greenhouse Gas Emissions Quotas as a Decarbonization Measure in the Electricity and Heat Supply Sectors
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Various options for quotas setting for GHG emissions in the power and district heating sectors are being considered (individual for each sector or a joint quota). The results of the application of the EPOS optimization model for a comprehensive assessment of the energy and economic consequences of the introduction of quota options under various scenarios of carbon regulation are presented.

articleTitle: Constructing the State Estimation Algorithms Based on Decomposition for the Fractional Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with the statement of the nonlinear task of estimating the dynamic system state, unknown parameters, and fractional order. The solution uses the decomposition approach, which includes Kalman filters, wavelets, fuzzy systems, neural networks, and their combinations. An example illustrates the problem solution with estimating algorithms accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Mathematical Models for Digital Twins in Flexible Discrete Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The authors reviewed the areas of application of digital twins in discrete manufacturing. Examples of specific implemented projects have shown that the urgent task is to create mathematical models of the process of technological preparation for flexible discrete production, covering a description of the stage of testing the product design for manufacturability. The authors developed a formalized description of flexible discrete manufacturing and a generalized model of flexible discrete manufacturing and identified areas of application of the developed models. Digital twins of products manufactured in flexible manufacturing can include developed models.

articleTitle: Model of Fuel Intake Management in Transport Holding
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The model of fuel intakee management in a holding is considered. Responsible manager (the Regulator) controls holding fuel intake. The holding has a service bureau headed by the Representative, advised by the Expert. This bureau has a subordinated unit (headed by the Superintendent) that directly serves the clients of the holding. Neither the Expert nor the Representative knows the minimum fuel intake of the unit. Thus, the Superintendent can manipulate the unit fuel intake to obtain better nomination from the Representative. Similarly, the Representative can manipulate the bureau's fuel intake order to influence the Regulator's decisions. Under these conditions, sufficient conditions are found under which both the Superintendent and the Representative are reducing fuel intake.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Goals Achievement Degree and Plans Implementation in Large-Scale Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In the article, the authors developed the task of verifying the achievability of a set of goals carried out in managing human-machine, economic, and social systems, as well as in their design and planning of activities. For checking achievability, we propose to use the formal apparatus of Boolean algebra, graph and production models, systems of linear homogeneous Kolmogorov-Chapman differential equations, and nonlinear differential equations of system dynamics.

articleTitle: Study of the Economic Growth of Oil and Gas Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Oil and gas have an impact on the Russian economy. On the one hand, oil prices affect the economic and political processes that determine the value of oil companies' shares, the speed of their economic growth, and the level of inflation in oil-importing countries, as well as the intensity of the processes of centralization and concentration of production. On the other hand, oil prices serve as a guide in the formation of energy carrier prices. The activity of the nation's financial institutions depends on the increase in oil prices. At the same time, increasing foreign exchange revenues have an impact on the banking industry's liquidity. This piques the attention of outside investors and aids in the inflow of foreign money into the national economy. The interest in the stock of Russian oil businesses is also impacted by the price increase, stimulating capital influx. A study of the impact of oil prices and the exchange rate of the national currency on the economic growth of oil and gas enterprises is presented in this article.

articleTitle: Balance Model of the Impact of Final Consumption on Economic Indicators
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A model of the diversified technological core of the economy, including the observed parameters of autonomous reproduction, is considered. The correlations between the vectors of output, value-added, additional final consumption of the state, and investments in capital formation are obtained. They made it possible to assess the nature and parameters of the impact of additional final consumption on economic performance

articleTitle: Modeling of Inflationary Processes with Expectations
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We are developing a new model of the inflationary processes. In this regard, origins of inflation and its development come into focus. A new formula for the relationship between the rates of inflation, money supply and macroeconomic growth is the main result of our research. Functions and role of economic expectations are in the spotlight. The inflationary processes are of interest in the context of the Bank of Russia's inflation-targeting policy.

articleTitle: The Comparative Assessment Methodology of the Demographic Situation in the Regions
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Authors proposed methodology that based on the joint use of regression analysis and ranking methods. The using of this methodology allows the comparative analysis of the demographic situation in different regions, the identification of the most effective parameters, and the form of the regional labor resources policy.

articleTitle: Features and Means of Forming Technological Forecasts of Energy Sector in Modern Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper examines the requirements for the formation of a technological forecast for the Russian energy sector, proposes a decomposition of forecast tasks for comparing technologies and variants of the technological profile of the energy production and consumption segments, identifies priority model tools, including optimization models, for a comprehensive assessment of the effects of technological renewal of the energy sector for the economy

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence in a Three-Level Organizational System (on the Example of the Agricultural Sector)
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The structure and management system of the agrarian sector of the economy, the network model of enterprises, and the possibility of using artificial intelligence in agricultural sectors are considered.

articleTitle: Quantitative Criteria for Classification of Small-World Networks for Industrial Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper examines the possibility of recognizing systems with the topology of small-world networks without a detailed analysis of their topological properties. For this, image recognition and machine learning methods are used. The conducted research allows us to conclude that recognition with learning gives better results in the correct classification of the small-world networks.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Set Indicator Monitoring of the Integrated Quality and Flight Safety Management System in Civil Aviation Organizations
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article discusses the issues of flight safety providing in civil aviation organizations (service providers), solved by investigating the uncertainty of the production state system based on the variety indicators monitoring of the integrated quality and flight safety management system. Modern analysis methods of vaguely measurable uncertainty are presented, which makes it possible to determine the level of production system risk in advance before the occurrence of adverse event conditions.

articleTitle: Ecosystem Business Models: A Study from the Point of View of Neo-Institutionalism and the Beginning of the Analysis of Their Profitability
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The functioning of Ecosystem Business Models developing in the Modern Economy requires their theoretical understanding, which the author proposes to implement based on Neo-Institutionalism. The author substantiates that Profitability analysis and Savings in Transaction Costs are the basis for making decisions about their creation and entering participants into them and offer basic models for their evaluation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Pension System of Chinese Citizens
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This scientific article analyzes the current pension system in China and the factors that influence the retirement income and expenses of Chinese citizens. The article describes the development of the pension system, its structure and the main types of pension systems for Chinese citizens. In addition, the article gives the rates of pension contributions in different provinces of China and gives the calculation of future pensions of working citizens with average salaries.

articleTitle: The Choice of Optimal Options for the Development of Transport Corridors in the Context of the Reorientation of Export Flows of Russian Companies
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the problem of choosing the optimal option for developing transport infrastructure (transport corridors) in the context of sanctions and the closure of some export markets for industrial companies in the Russian Federation. The development of transport corridors will allow companies to reorient their export flows to other markets without losing financial stability. The problem is formulated as a dynamic production and transport problem with mixed variables, including the choice of options for developing the transport network. Methods for its solution are discussed. The results of a series of calculations are shown in an illustrative example. The solution to the problem makes it possible to choose the optimal options for the development of transport infrastructure and, at the same time, the optimal volumes of production and supply of products of companies, considering the dynamics of changes in the capacity of export markets and other constraints, using various scenarios for changing the source data and assumptions.

articleTitle: Model Stress Test of the Russian Economy with a Collapse in Energy Exports
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The long-term macroeconomic multiplier effects of foreign sanctions pressure on the domestic fuel and energy industries are being studied. A scenario approach and calculations on an inter-industry model were used. The results of the calculations showed that the fall in Russian energy exports and the reduction in investment in the fuel industries can significantly slow down the development of the country's economy.

articleTitle: Forecasting Time Series of Financial Indicators Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper explores the possibility of using several different architectures of artificial neural networks to construct forecasts for financial indicators of a group of countries. The analysis is based on data collected from the World Bank databases, the Financial Development Index, and the United Nations.

articleTitle: A Model of the Wave Displacement of Hard-to-recover Oil Fields Reservoirs by Active Reagents
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: When extracting hard-to-recover oil reserves using active reagents, high-frequency nonlinear wave oscillations accelerate diffusion and lead to an increase in the oil recovery factor of deposits. The paper contains results of numerical experiments using a mathematical model of cylindrical waves in the direction of the filtration flow of fluids; it also demonstrates the effectiveness of cyclic control wave actions.

articleTitle: Robust Non-linear Controller for Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, a special kind of non-linear discontinuous feedback is proposed. It provides stabilization of the main parameter of the buck (step-down) converter, namely the output voltage. It is essential, that the input voltage and the load consumption current are unknown parameters. The idea, is to use so-called "vortex algorithms". These algorithms are able to provide robust properties of the plant, considering external unmatched disturbances. Numerical simulation has been carried out, which confirms the performance of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithms for Informative Features Extraction to Predict the Aircraft Electromechanical Systems Technical Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes optimization algorithms for identifying informative features for predicting the aircraft electromechanical systems' technical conditions using spectral and time series analysis. The article presents the study results concerning developed algorithms on the data obtained using a mathematical model of the unmanned aerial vehicle's electromechanical actuator.

articleTitle: Forecasting Indicators of Region Economic Development using Financial Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper is devoted to considering the methodology of economic analysis for managing regional development based on financial modeling and estimates obtained using both statistical observations and financial reporting data of Russian companies. Particular attention is paid to comparing estimates of gross value added (GVA) within the framework of the Statistics National Accounts methodology and based on financial reporting data, which may be of interest for expanding the information base for the analysis of regional authorities. The article formulates proposals on possible directions for using GVA estimates by state/regional authorities for a retrospective analysis of the state and dynamics of the regional economy, issues of regional economic policy, and the development of investment programs for the regional economy. They are illustrated using the example of the Krasnoyarsk Territory.

articleTitle: Research of the Filtering Features of Dynamic Tracking Differentiators of Different Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We have developed a procedure for designing a general tracking differentiator with sigmoid correction, which smoothes and restores derivatives of reference signals and generates realizable trajectories, considering the physical limitations of a particular control plant. We also show that increasing the dynamic order of the differentiator provides natural filtering of the processed noisy signal.

articleTitle: The Behavior of Agents During Lockdown
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of a social planner who seeks to maximize his discounted utility from consumption over a finite time. The authors found the optimal control and account state trajectory, and investigated the optimal trajectory under different discount factors. The authors proved the "convexity" criterion for a constant bank rate.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Multirotor Aircraft in Case of Failure of One Engine
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: As the number of UAVs in the delivery industry has increased over the years, the slightest engine-related failure can lead to a crash, hence loss or damage to the cargo. The paper focuses on a proposed solution to this problem by stabilizing the UAV in the event of a single engine failure.

articleTitle: New Approaches to Assessing the Level of Innovation Development of the Republic of Belarus
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The aim of the article is to research the best trajectory of the innovative and technological advancement of the Republic of Belarus in the context of the development of the information society. The paper proposes the system of indicators, characterizing the innovative development of Belarus in 2012-2021, and calculates the generalized average growth rate of these indicators. In the article the author proposed the Composite Index that includes the dynamics of the sub-indices of the Global Innovation Index for the Republic of Belarus for 2012-2021 and characterize the development of technologies and the results of creative activity. In accordance with the methodological aspects of cliodynamics, taking into account the time lag of mutual influence, graphical models of the dependence of the Composite Index of Technological Development and the proposed indicators of innovative development of the Republic of Belarus are constructed. The model of the dependence of the most significant factors of the country's innovative development on the Composite Index of Technological Development has been created. The paper discusses recommendations for improving the country's innovative infrastructure taking into account the priority innovative and technological indicators.

articleTitle: Information and Modeling Support for the Concept of Monitoring Spatial-Sectoral Development of Regional Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper presents a formulation of tasks for developing a large-scale monitoring concept aimed at improving the quality of planning the sectoral and spatial development of regional economies. Considered approach proposes for building an information system that uses the transformation of communication strategies under various conditions involving technological infrastructure as digital entities in local markets.

articleTitle: Modeling the Performance of IEEE 802.11ac WLAN Network for Remote Visual SLAM
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the results of analyzing existing approaches and models to estimate bandwidth and delays in the wireless channel, as well as energy consumption and maximum operating time of a robot/unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) when using visual simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) algorithms with remote data transmission and processing via an IEEE 802.11ac wireless network. Simulation modeling for estimating channel throughput, mean value of delay, packet delivery ratio, energy and power cost for transmission (based on the considered models and approaches), and the maximum possible flight time of a UAV in hovering mode when transmitting data between the robot and the conditional remote data processing server was carried out. In general, data pre-processing on the UAV side (feature identification, extraction, and coding, etc.) and sending the resulting data to the server for further processing and retrieval of keyframes/map updates should be considered for practical field tests of remote visual SLAM algorithms.

articleTitle: Risk Management in the Design of Security Systems with Nested Security Zones
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Security system risk management problems are often solved using scenario analysis methods for risk assessment. This method models various attack scenarios on the system to be defended. Many studies consider the risks of a system with elements isolated from each other. At the same time, it is evident that the system’s structure can significantly affect the final values of the integral risk. This study applies previously obtained research results on the influence of complex system structure on their integral risk on security system design. The article considers how the structure of a security system affects its integral risk. The result of the study is the algorithm to design such systems to minimize costs at the operational stage.

articleTitle: Fragment Analysis and Weighting Coefficients for Intelligent Text Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We propose a data processing and computing system based on intelligent text monitoring using fragment analysis and weights. We describe a computation technique to account for functional tokens in materials under study with reference to the number of characters in the text.

articleTitle: Neuro-Fuzzy Models for Assessing and Predicting Hazards in Civil Aviation
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the development of various types of mathematical models of cyber-physical systems based on fuzzy logic and neural network technologies for flight safety analysis, using specific examples to study the applicability of the proposed models for hazards analysis and also explores approaches to the implementation of mathematical tools in the flight safety control system.

articleTitle: On Solvability Conditions for Nonlinear Equations and Equilibrium Price
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We study the coincidence point problem for smooth mappings of finite-dimensional spaces. We obtain sufficient conditions for the existence of coincidence points without the standard assumption on the covering constants and the Lipschitz property of the mappings. We derive existence conditions in terms of the classical derivative of the mappings under consideration and in terms of Clarke’s generalized Jacobian. We discuss the application of the obtained results to the equilibrium price existence problem in nonlinear market models.

articleTitle: Flows on Solutions of Finite Type Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes a method for studying systems of partial differential equations resolved with respect to the time derivative. The right-hand sides of such systems should depend only on spatial variables, the unknown function, as well as the derivatives of the unknown function with respect to spatial variables. We use the theory of symmetries of completely integrable distributions.

articleTitle: Reduction of the Optimal Tracking Problem Using PID Control Laws
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
