abstract: The author considers the problem of optimal tracking with a given reference trajectory and singular disturbances for the case of proportional-integral-differential control laws. The application of the decoupling method, based on the use of the technique of integral manifolds of fast and slow motions, allows one to reduce the system under consideration to systems of lower dimension.

articleTitle: Construction of Guaranteeing Controls in the Model of the Production Subsystem of the Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper examines a model of the production subsystem of an enterprise operating under conditions of uncertainty. The set of possible values of uncertain factors is specified using a scenario tree. Statements of optimization problems for finding guaranteeing controls are presented. Their solution is demonstrated using a numerical example.

articleTitle: Information Oligopolistic Markets: Supply Differentiation and its Impact on the Efficiency of Commercial Activity
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Competition in oligopolistic markets can be defined as the process of mutual influence of companies, considering different amounts of awareness and principles of response to each other’s actions. The volume of promotional (commercial) activity can be considered a strategic variable when modeling competition processes. A high degree of penetration brings oligopolistic competition to the level of competition in terms of customer acquisition costs. Maintaining a differentiated offer affects the effectiveness of customer acquisition and, as a result, smoothes the positions of competing companies with initially different parameters of response to each other’s actions.

articleTitle: From a Complex of Models to a Platform for Strategic Management on Transport Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: To support decision-making related to the development of transport infrastructure, is proposed to use the complex of models for the strategic management, tested in strategic planning of the sustainable functioning of the Russian economy. Based on this complex, a design solution developed to create a platform for the strategic management of large-scale transport infrastructure.

articleTitle: Development of Modern Forecasting Models
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper analyzed ensemble forecasting models. The results showed that ensemble models can improve forecasting performance by compensating for the shortcomings of weak models.

articleTitle: Modeling Intermittent Protest Campaigns
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper studies protest campaigns consisting of both days with protest activity and days without activity. A dynamical agent-based model has been constructed. Numerical experiments showed that repression reduces the surviving probability of the campaign, but moderate repression may increase the turnout for the campaigns that survive.

articleTitle: About Formalization of Optimization Criteria Math-Net.Ru: Goals, Opportunities, Support, Application
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We discuss further improving the Math-Net.Ru database and propose formal indicators of its usefulness and convenience for different categories of users and support staff. Also we discuss some possible measures to improve (optimize) these indicators.

Author Keywords: information systems to support scientific research

articleTitle: Methodological Provisions and Algorithms for Estimating Power Losses for Friction and Ventilation During Operation of a Steam Turbine in Motor Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of determining the operating modes of steam turbine stages in low-steam and motor modes (MM) is considered. The analysis and generalization of existing methods for estimating losses on heating and ventilation in steam turbines is given, the possibility of their application in the motor mode is considered, and a new technique is proposed that takes into account the peculiarities of the hydrodynamic processes occurring in the active stages of a steam turbine in steamless, low-steam and motor modes. It is shown that the uncertainty of calculating friction and ventilation losses and considering the importance of the value of these losses in modeling the temperature state of steam turbine stages when they operate in steamless and motor modes, the need to develop a methodology for estimating these losses, taking into account the features of these modes, is an urgent task. To assess the totality of power losses for friction and ventilation in the motor mode, a calculation technique is proposed, which is based on the condition that the stage goes into ventilation mode when the heat transfer on the stage is less than its minimum value for power generation. Based on this condition, calculation formulas are obtained that will allow calculating the totality of friction and ventilation losses in the steam turbine stages and in the turbine as a whole during the operation of the steam turbine in MM with known: geometric parameters of the stage; steam pressure distribution along the flow part of the turbine; steam consumption through the steps.

Author Keywords: power loss for friction and ventilation

articleTitle: Information Risks of the Internet of Things Complex Assessment: Confidentiality
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Internet of Things technologies are currently rapidly developing. They provide partial or complete automation in production, security, and household spheres. However, given the amount of data that the Internet of Things currently operates with, it is necessary to improve methods and approaches to the information security of such systems. The article proposes to pay attention to assessing information risks as an aspect of information security. This paper studies the use of the complex assessment mechanism to assess the security level of the Internet of Things by analyzing information risks. We propose an approach to assess the confidentiality of a system as a component of the integral information risk. The proposed approach consists of seven stages. The assessment is made by comparing vulnerabilities and possible attacks on the system (stages 1–4), as well as using typical mechanisms of complex assessment (stages 5–7). The second section contains a description of the approach itself. The third section of the paper contains examples of possible scales and values of criteria for complex assessment. The importance of this approach is to calculate the local risk for further assessment of the security level of the system.

articleTitle: Design and Deployment of Geoportal Systems to Provide Support for Management Decision-Making in Natural-Social-Production Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes of the solution to the problem of managing large-scale natural-social-production systems using geoportal technologies. A model for using a system for remote monitoring and control of spatially distributed objects based on the concept of the Internet of Things is proposed. The core of the system is geoportals, which function as a tool for dispatching and monitoring spatial objects. The authors describe a system for remote monitoring and control of spatially distributed objects based on the concept of the Internet of Things using LoRa network technology. The core of the presented system is geoportals that function as a tool for dispatching and monitoring spatial objects with the function of visualizing them on a digital map. The project operates based on web technologies, realizing the possibility of monitoring the transmitted state of objects and remote control (in particular, the function of controlling the microclimate, closing/opening doors, and automated irrigation).

articleTitle: Management of Scientific Agricultural Digital Ecosystems Based on Ecosystem Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers a mathematical model for managing a scientific digital ecosystem exemplified by the agriculture case; the model enables assessing the impact science exerts on the regions’ socioeconomic position in order to build an adequate response to the advanced economies’ regime of severe sanctions against Russia. For these purposes, a systemic analysis of the subject identification and classification of ecosystems was conducted to address the critical issue of determining the basic concepts and terms of the country’s digitalization.

articleTitle: Conceptual Approach in Structuring the Semantic Core Author's Text
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Proposed conceptual approach for the linguistic analysis author's text by structuring its semantic core with homogeneous and heterogeneous semantic networks, with a final synthesis based on the removal of semantic contradictions. Used semantic search and method for highlighting text topics of intellectual monitoring.

articleTitle: Plan Implementation and Data Revelation in Active Organizational Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of constructing a correct planning mechanism in an active system. Correct mechanisms encourage agents to report reliable data to the Principal and implement assigned plans. The necessary and sufficient conditions for the correctness of the mechanism obtained. There is the optimal mechanism in the class of correct mechanisms.

articleTitle: On the Application of Agricultural Productivity Assessment Models for Developing Regions
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The possibility of using models for assessing productivity in agriculture (animal husbandry and crop production) developed for the Moscow region in other regions is considered. The structure of specific branches of agriculture in a particular region is analyzed, and the use of the proposed models is substantiated.

articleTitle: EBIOS and FSTEC Risk Assessment Method Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article aims to compare two risk assessment methods: EBIOS and FSTEC. EBIOS is published by the National Cybersecurity Agency of France (ANSSI), while FSTEC originates from Russia. Both methods are used relatively locally, but prove capable in France and Russia respectively. This article briefly describes those methods and compares them. The following research is subjective, and the author compares those methods based on his personal preferences, since no other such comparisons are known. During the research, both methods are briefly described and compared since both have appropriate pros and cons, while both may perform better in a particular situation. It leads to the conclusion that the application of both such methods can prove effective, and the main goal is to choose the most suitable approach for a particular situation.

articleTitle: Information System for Assessing Motor Memory in the Tasks of Ergatic System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An information evaluation system designed to assess the operator’s motor memory has been developed and realized as a software product. The system evaluates control commands generated by the user, through a traditional communication channel involving upper limb movement and alternative channels involving head or eye movement. The results allow for the evaluation of the operator’s individual typological features.

articleTitle: Preliminary Formulation of the Problem of Creating the Support Method for the Subject of Structural Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We believe that, at present, researchers cannot develop an effective method of support due to insufficient theoretical knowledge about structural identification. The work contains a new approach to the development of the combined support method. This approach, in particular, includes the comprehensive application of the system approach, the principle of considering structural identification and the problem of creating a combined support method as system objects, and the comprehensive application of an interdisciplinary approach. Taken together, the new results provide a preliminary formulation of the problem of creating a combined support method.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach to Exploring Ecological Determinacy of Socially Significant Diseases in Moscow
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A study of the relationship between some selected environmental indicators and the presence of socially significant diseases in the population of Moscow was carried out. A statistically significant correlation was confirmed. Machine learning models were built during the regression analysis. A web interface was developed to automate the processes of predicting the population’s morbidity.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Navigation Algorithm Using Laser Rangefinder And Odometry In Static Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This method is proposed for position correction and the mobile robot movement course in an environment with a known position of obstacles and equipped with a set of laser rangefinders and an odometer. The advantages of the considered algorithm are the low requirements for the computing power of the onboard computer and the possibility of using the laser rangefinders instead of an expensive lidar.

articleTitle: Low-Speed Underwater Robot Control under Parametric and External Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The control plant is a low-speed, fully-actuated underwater robot, the mathematical model of which contains uncertain parameters. Based on the system’s transformation to a canonical form, a control law with uncertainty compensation is developed. We have proposed a state and disturbance observer with piecewise linear corrective actions, which provides information support for the control law.

articleTitle: Organization of Modeling of the Transport Complex
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An approach to creating a technology for scenario modeling of a transport complex that supports hierarchical structures, models, calculations, and scenarios is presented. The application of technology involves multivariate calculations, analysis of the results, and assessment of the consequences of decision-making. The scenario is set by the values of exogenous variables, and variants of the calculation of variables. An essential stage of technology is described - automated generation of calculation programs. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Analysis of Urban Employee Basic Medical Insurance in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article reveals the four stages of development of China's employee health insurance system since 1950: 1) the period of the planned economy, 2) the period of the modern health insurance system, 3) the period of stable Moreover, since 1994, China has been using medical savings accounts (MSAs) as an essential, component of the urban health financing system. The article summarizes the six primary components of the operation of China's employee health insurance. The article also reveals the characteristics of employee health insurance in terms of contributions and use: encouragement for citizens to take care of their health, the healthy development of medical institutions, differentiation of reimbursement, and hierarchy of medical services.

articleTitle: The Management Problem of Information and Telecommunication Systems Development
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article analyses the key characteristics of information and telecommunications systems, identifies weaknesses, explores strategies for addressing these weaknesses, and presents a roadmap for managing system development, consisting of several distinct tasks.

articleTitle: Fast-Growing Organizations in Russia: Growth versus Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The work examines the financial sustainability indicators of fast-growing organizations. The revenue dynamics of fast-growing organizations is modeled by a logistic curve. The model considers the following indicators of financial sustainability: current liquidity, financial leverage. The model is illustrated by calculations based on data from Russian organizations. About 2 thousand fast-growing organizations of all types of activities have been identified. We conclude that some indicators of financial stability for the considered sample of fast-growing organizations look more risky, but do not lead to a judgment of significant risks.

articleTitle: An Approach to Locating Unknown Sources of Increased Air Emissions
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We are considering determining the locations of sources with exceeding emissions of atmospheric pollutants in a given area. In the report, we present one of the options for formalizing such a problem. In our approach, we assume that there is a set of known sources within the considered area which are expected to emit a declared amount of pollutant. Additionally, there may be unidentified sources of this pollutant. Let’s suppose that the measurements at the monitoring points exceed the modeled cumulative emissions of the registered sources. In this case, we want to understand where the violation occurs. The violation could come from the registered sources that exceed their declared emissions. The violation can also be expressed in the appearance of new pollutant sources. The analysis considers the registered climatic data for the examined time intervals. Specifically, the weather stability class for different time intervals is determined using cloudiness information from an online service’s API and atmospheric pressure, air temperature, and wind velocity data in the measurements database. Furthermore, we propose identifying the suspected areas of violations through iterations of simulating increased emissions from various points in the studied area using a Gaussian plume model and comparing the results with actual data. The report presents a general scheme of this approach and calculations obtained in its first two stages. The accuracy of the implemented mathematical model is evaluated. Conclusions are drawn regarding the advantages and limitations of the Gaussian plume model for the considered tasks.

articleTitle: Features of Modeling the Russian Gas Industry under Changing External Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to the features of optimization modeling of the Russian gas industry for the long term in the face of external changes. The gas industry considers primary production areas to mitigate negative impacts from external changes, including deep processing, LNG liquefaction and transportation.

articleTitle: Batch Auctions
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article continues to work on studingthe problem of resource allocation in the network model. The proposed approach with auctions requires a methodology for setting the problem and its implementation in network models. The work describes a batch auction, formulates the task of the auctioneer, and proposes a scheme for implementing a contract in the blockchain network.

articleTitle: Mechanisms For Information Enhancement In Distributed Intelligent Network Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the problem of significant information enhancement in distributed intelligent systems within the quantum theory approach. We propose a laser-like (solaser) model for a social complex network analysis. The introduced model describes phenomena such as the emergence of echo chambers, social polarization, and the growth of information cascades.

articleTitle: Dynamic Approach to the Analysis of Financial Structure: Overcoming the Bank-Based vs Market-Based Dichotomy
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A conceptual approach to the typology of countries' financial development has been developed, which will allow government authorities to make more accurate macroeconomic forecasts and apply a strategic approach to economic development planning. Modeling was conducted to analyze the impact of macroeconomic indicators, dummy variables of economic crises, and the technological component variable on indicators of financial development and variables characterizing the structure of the financial system.

articleTitle: Managing the Highly Automated Vehicles Life Cycle for Providing Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This article presents approaches to managing highly automated vehicles' life cycle in consideration of providing safety. The authors introduce the system engineering method for developing safe systems and provide an example for how it may be applied in the corresponding field. The capabilities for instrumentalization of the suggested method with goal to automate operation on safe system life cycle stages are examined.

articleTitle: Analysis of Approximating and Detailing Wavelet Decomposition Coefficients in the Risk Potential Predictive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper addresses the challenges related to the information task of an APCS used in nuclear power plants. Specifically, it discusses the development of predictive models capable of calculating technical and economic indicators, utilizing essential parameters of the power unit. The models are built by conducting a thorough analysis of wavelet decomposition coefficients, ensuring accurate approximation and detailed analysis. Additionally, the paper presents an improved algorithm for evaluating the risk potential associated with the technological process.

articleTitle: Using Input-Output Tables for Assessment Structural Changes in the Russian Transport Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers key aspects of structural changes in the transport sector of the Russian Federation in the period from 2000 to 2018. The research is based on the latest update of the Inter-country Input-Output Tables (ICIO) while focusing on the international linkages and their impact on the Russian transport sector and their components. In general, the contribution of inter-country transport and logistics supply chains involving Russia to economic growth has markedly increased in the period under review. Also, the recent developments in the main transport sub-sectors have been characterized by significant heterogeneity. The author concludes that, by 2018, integration of the Russian transport sector into the GVCs has approached to an optimal level.

articleTitle: Flexible Modeling System: Steam Generator Level Calculation
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents a mathematical model for calculating an NPP power unit's steam generator (SG) level with a VVER-1000 reactor, part of a flexible modeling system (FMS). The distributed model of an SG is designed for a more detailed description of processes in a two-phase volume of SG and modeling the readings of level gauges in non-stationary operating modes. The results of verification of the presented model as part of the FMS in the dynamic mode (disconnection of one turbopump pump from two operating ones) of the NPP power unit are presented.

articleTitle: Simulation Games in Geopolitical Problems Exploring
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper discusses issues related to the use of simulation games to explore geopolitical issues. In the example of the geopolitical game held under the leadership of N.N. Moiseev at the Computing Center of the USSR Academy of Sciences in the 1970s, imitation support tools and the game itself are described.

articleTitle: Sectoral Management of Secondary Resources Based on Information in the State Digital Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: the developed methodology of industry management based on the control of flows and volumes of information on the movement of material and financial resources in Russian market of secondary ferrous metals is present. This will make it possible to effectively implement an ecosystem project related to the turnover of metals under existing legislation.

articleTitle: Control of the Predator-Prey System Based on the Expansion of the State Space
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses the two-dimensional modified Lotka-Volterra model. An approach based on expanding the state space is used in order to stabilize the number of preys. The observer recovers unmeasured variables and noise.

articleTitle: Gas Stations Performance Modeling in Terms of Geoanalytics
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A conceptual approach has been developed to solve the location problem, allowing commercial organizations that own gas stations to assess the degree of influence of geographical characteristics of locations on profitability indicators. Data collection, processing, and spatial analysis have been conducted to build a model for forecasting financial results.

articleTitle: Methodological Feature in the System Support of the Large Ergatic Systems Technical Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper shows methodological possibilities of using the situational approach to support the large ergatic system technical condition. The ensuring the spacecraft operation functional reliability example uses the system mechanisms provisions proposes to increase the efficiency of the technical condition controlling in the on-board equipment as a complex ergatic system during the spacecraft in orbit operation.

articleTitle: Build or Buy? Synergy Evaluation in M&A
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to develop methods for assessing the synergistic effect in M&A transactions based on the use of dynamic production and financial models. Much of the literature on the synergy effect of M&A transactions usually focuses on a specific type of synergy. At the same time, this article proposes an approach that considers the cumulative effect of various types of operational and financial synergies. We use the TEO-INVEST software package to build production and financial models of companies. The model includes several blocks, each of which must be customized to the specifics of the company. The proposed approach allows us to take into account all changes in the value chain of the parent company during the consolidation of acquired companies and their impact on changes in the company's net cash flow. The method allows you to evaluate and select investment options in the vertical integration of a company, consisting of alternatives - buy an existing production asset or build a new production facility. Examples of applying the proposed method for choosing investment decisions are given in the example of a metallurgical company.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logical-Linguistic Analysis of Data Quality in Financial Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The proposed approach to the analysis of data quality is based on the use of the apparatus of fuzzy logical-linguistic analysis by L. Zadeh. The indicators are presented in the form of linguistic variables, the semantics of which are set by experts. The constructed hierarchy of indicators makes it possible to increase the scientific validity of decisions while ensuring the quality of data in financial systems.

articleTitle: The Energy Generation in Synchronous Drive Based on Vortex Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of the output voltage of a synchronous generator regulation is considered in the paper. We assume, that the generator has symmetrical windings. The control inputs are synthesized with the help of a switch converter, which is connected to a capacitor and a storage battery. To form a given output voltage, the desired values for the currents in the generator stator windings are computed, taking into account their active resistance and the value of the external load, which is either estimated using the state observer or assumed to be known. According to the computed reference currents, the control inputs for the switch power converter are synthesized.

articleTitle: Parametric Identification of External Disturbances in the Problem of Indoor Microclimate Control
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An experimental approach to parametric identification of microclimate dynamics and models of external uncontrollable disturbances for a building microclimate control system is discussed. Data from the weather station and four microclimate sensors in two neighbouring identical rooms were analysed; sunlight access to one of them was significantly constrained. A predictive model of the room microclimate was designed, involving the factors of outdoor temperature and sunlight.

articleTitle: Combined Optima
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Several definitions of combined optimums are given. Sufficient conditions for their existence are found. One player chooses the combined optimum because deviation from the optimum does not increase their payoff. The other player does not deviate from the optimum because it does not increase the partner’s payoff.

articleTitle: Modeling of Regulator Operation for Controlling Objects with Asymmetric Backlash
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper discusses the pulse PID controller IPIDO, designed for controlling objects with asymmetric backlash and the simulation model of this controller. The simulation model is used to study the performance of the IPIDO regulator compared to the regulators compensating only symmetrical backlash.

articleTitle: Financial Analysis of the Company's Project Portfolio
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of functioning in a large-scale enterprise focused on export-import activities. Strategic management approaches in the financial sector are used, and the tasks of managing the portfolio of enterprise projects are formalized.

articleTitle: Positive Feedback in the Public Administration Intellectual Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The intellectual ecosystem of public administration is presented based on the concept of James Moore (the new ecology of competition and the approach to building an ecosystem). In the intellectual ecosystem, symbiotic intelligence aims to implement the positive feedback of public administration. Positive feedback is carried out through the interaction of artificial intelligence with the natural intelligence of all stakeholders.

articleTitle: Control Model of a Warehouse Transport Robot with Adaptive Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of controlling an autonomous transport robot with a differential drive for use in indoor warehouses. We use odometers and microwave Doppler sensors to measure wheel speed. The robot motion control system maintains a slight orientation angle between adjacent waypoints for improved accuracy. For this, if necessary, the possibility of embedding an adapted section in the trajectory is provided.

articleTitle: Numerical Solution of the Pursuit Problem on a Half-Plane
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The work is devoted to solving the dynamic conflict problem of pursuit on the half-plane. The system of conflict equilibria for differential games developed by E. R. Smolyakov was used to find a solution. The numerical solution of the problem compared with the exact solution obtained analytically to estimate the error.

articleTitle: Quadratic and Cubic Approximations of a Single-Machine Power System Model with PSS
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper presents the results of building quadratic and cubic approximations of a non-linear space state single-machine power system model. The synchronous generator model accounts for the action of an automatic excitation regulator, a power system stabilizer, and damper windings. The approximations developed are useful for analytical studies of non-linear modal interactions in power systems with linear and bilinear control.

articleTitle: Sampling Satellite Data for Constructing a Global Model of the Magnetic Field of Mars
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: Using a linear integral representation method and raw satellite data, we constructed analytical models of the crustal magnetic field of Mars. We used spherical, rectangular grids with equal-area dimensions to sample data. We analyzed satellite measurements and introduced several criteria for possible sampling while creating magnetic field models of Mars.

articleTitle: Critical Conditions of a Thermal Explosion in the Case of Autocatalytic Combustion with Account Reagent and Oxidant Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The work deals with the classical problem of the critical conditions for self–ignition of a gas mixture. The authors presents a reasonably general combustion model that takes into account the consumption of the reactant and oxidizer. The model allows for fractional degrees of reaction orders, including the possibility of taking into account autocatalysis by the reactant and oxidizer. We consider parameters characterizing the heat transfer and the ambient temperature as a control actions. The work pays special attention to the first-order autocatalytic reaction for the reactant. The study shows that control actions can change combustion modes from slow burnout to thermal explosion. Using the technique of invariant manifolds and canards, asymptotic formulas for the critical value of the control parameter are obtained. We point out the exceptionally high sensitivity of the model to changes in the control parameter near its critical value.

articleTitle: Voice Technologies in Control of Strategic Development Large-Scale systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A modern tool for managing the development of the digital economy is digital platforms for multi-agent control and regulation of processes for achieving strategic goals. These are centers for the merging and processing of big data streams, represented by diverse and multi-level time series of hundreds and thousands of development indicators. The large-scale and ultrahigh information intensity of problems solved within the digital platform requires the development of organizational and information support for collaborative multi-agent activities based on open semantic technology for intelligent systems. To solve this problem, an approach is proposed based on the currently actively developing conversational artificial intelligence protocols.

articleTitle: Solving the Problem of Detecting and Resolving Conflicts in Airspace Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The report examines promising algorithms for detecting and resolving aviation conflicts. These are problem-solving algorithms based on hierarchical deep reinforcement learning for flights along given routes and the actor-critic algorithm for free flights.

articleTitle: Opinion Formation and Social Impact in Networks with Natural and Artificial Intelligence Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: We suggest a new quantum-like approach to study distributed intelligence systems (DIS) consisting of natural (owners) and artificial (avatars) intelligence agents organized in a scale-free network. We demonstrate the complex features of social impact in DIS that imply the hierarchical formation of opinion leaders in the network and their topological protection. We elucidated the effect of significant narrowing of the spread of opinions within the network when most owners chose their position as limiting (extreme).

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Indoor Space Temperature Distribution by Point Measurements for the Comfort Level Control Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An approach to studying the dynamic characteristics of the indoor environment in individual public rooms for the microclimate control problem is proposed. A numerical procedure combining computational fluid dynamics and network airflow methods makes it possible to simulate the operation of a measuring complex, design an expedient sensor network, and reduce the time of building inspection when deploying a centralized microclimate control system.

articleTitle: The State Of Population Health Of Russians: Models And Concepts
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The main indicator of the harmonious development of any society is the positive demographic growth of the population and a high level of quality of life, which are directly related to the public (population) health of society. In the process of human evolution at different times, Humanity has gone through 5 stages of population health: from primitive, post-primitive, quasi-modern, modern to postmodern type. Currently, there is a modern type of public health in many countries. In Russia today, the quasi-modern type prevails, which is associated with negative demographic processes: for the period 2010-2020, the number of children born decreased by 21.6%, deaths by 1.4%. In Russia, there is a decrease in the population, which in 2010 amounted to 1.7, and in 2020 it increased to 4.8. Among the leading risk factors for death and loss of the Russian population, such as high blood pressure (35.5%), hypercholesterolemia (23%), smoking (17.1%), unhealthy diet (12.9%) prevail, obesity (12.5%), alcohol abuse (11.9%) and low physical activity (9%).

articleTitle: Models of Joint Agricultural Insurance and Hedging of Price Risks for Manufactured Product
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers various formulations of the problem of optimal joint agricultural insurance and hedging. As examples, the two most well–known crop and income insurance programs and two methods of price hedging are considered - hedging with futures and PUT options.

articleTitle: Machine Learning. Correlational Convolution Method for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: When classifying images, in order to reduce the dimension of the feature space, it is necessary to convolve images to select a subset of pixels sufficient to solve the problem. An image convolution method based on the correlation of the pixels of images of the training sample with a teacher with an approximated function used for classification is proposed. An example of image convolution used to classify handwritten digits by evaluating the posterior probabilities of ten image classes using Anderson's discriminant function is given.

articleTitle: Safe Internet Tunnel with Access Control Features to Web-services Based on SSL/TLS Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: An approach to providing a secure interaction in distributed systems over Internet based on the organization of safe communication channels (tunnels) founded on SSL/TLS protocol is considered. Unlike VPN technology, the described approach provides support only for HTTP/SOAP interactions, which allows you to include features such as queries routing, authentication and access control to information resources based on client public key certificates as ready-made technical solutions within the tunnel. The implementation of the approach in the Linux environment and the results of an experimental study are described.

articleTitle: Overview of Modern Forecasting Methods and Models
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The development of accurate forecasting models for financial time series is an essential area of research in finance and economics. The article describes modern models and forecasting methods.

articleTitle: Multi-agent Management Architecture under Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The task of selecting the management architecture of multi-agent systems in the context of hopping multiple goals and actions of agents based on microservices is discussed. The present paper has shown that the use of a microservice management architecture in intelligent transport systems as an arbitrary subset of independent subsystems with different functionality will reduce the financial and time costs of servicing transportation on combined routes.

articleTitle: Managing the Development of Dental Care Using Digital Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: In the scientific article, based on social financial technologies, an economic and mathematical model of the development of a dental clinic in the manufacture and implementation of fixed structures of dentures using digital and analog methods in the production process has been developed in two versions: a single crown and a bridge prosthesis (two supporting crowns and two artificial teeth). The authors carried out the timing of the work of dental technicians at the laboratory stages of analog and digital production of polymer fixed structures of dentures. The results of chronometric observations of the manufacture of a single crown using analog and digital protocols showed that the time spent by a technician in digital manufacturing (97.78 min.) is 3.31 times less than the time spent by a dental technician using an analog protocol (393.31 min.), and in the manufacture of a bridge prosthesis, the digital protocol requires 3.22 times less time than analog, which proves the huge superiority of digital technologies over analog. The average time spread of a dental technician at the laboratory stages of the digital protocol is significantly less than the analog one, which indicates greater stability of digital technologies compared to analog ones in the manufacture of fixed denture structures. On the example of the actual data of the Clinical Center of Dentistry of the Clinic of A.I. Yevdokimov Moscow State University of Medicine and Dentistry it is shown that the profitability of a bridge prosthesis using an analog protocol is negative, and the excess of the profitability of a digital protocol in relation to an analog one for a single crown is 9.92 times, which proves the economic efficiency of using three-dimensional printing in combination with social financial technologies compared with analog methods of manufacturing prototype prostheses.

articleTitle: Wheeled-Robot Orientation and Navigation Algorithm Using Visual-Inertial System
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The article reviews algorithms used to determine the position and orientation of a wheeled robot based on the odometric data, inertial sensors, and a camera. The authors present mathematical models of robot navigation for a flat surface. The authors consider the problem solution to exemplify the position determining for a TurtleBot3 Burger mobile robot.

articleTitle: Local Controllability in the Problem with Variable Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: With this paper we investigate the controllability with changing phase space problem. There has recently been a growing interest in controllability problems of variable structure because of the expansion of their practical application area. Such problems arise in physics, biology, and economics. On the given time intervals, our problem of transferring an object from the given set of space to the given set of other space through a point zero is considered. The motion of an object is expressed via two nonlinear systems of differential equations, and the controlling influence of the system has a specific form due to physical applications. The transition of the object from initial space to second is specified by some mapping. Concerning the problem at which the nonlinear system in the first space - it is locally zero-controlled, plus the righthand part of the system in the other space admits linearization under some conditions, sufficient controllability conditions are obtained.

articleTitle: Stability in Games with Uncertain Factors
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The maximal guaranteed result in a hierarchical game with an undetermined factor is found in the class of strategies with feedback. The stability of the problem under consideration concerning perturbations of the payoff function of the lower-level player is studied. Regularizing estimates are obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis of Almost-periods of Vibration Signals of an Electric Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper discusses the period analysis of a vibration signal taken from the publicly available Machinery Fault Database (MAFAULDA) dataset. The theoretical background of the methods used to analyze periodicity in a time series is presented. The definition of almost-period is given and the mathematical apparatus of shift functions for its search is described. The study and search of almost-periods in a vibration signal using shift function are described.

articleTitle: On the Task of Dividing EEG Data by Brain Zones for Application in Robot Control
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: The study discussed in this paper contributes to the extensive interdisciplinary research dedicated to developing a method for controlling robots using human bioelectrical signals. The focus of this research is on investigating the signals obtained through electroencephalography (EEG), assessing their representativeness, and exploring the potential for clustering these signals. A crucial aspect examined is the hypothesis that signals originating from different regions of the brain can be effectively separated and accurately identified. The paper presents the outcomes of an experiment involving the induction of stable visual evoked potentials in human subjects, followed by the creation of a practical database based on these findings. The proposed approach involves extracting significant features from the EEG signal through the application of machine learning methods. The efficiency and practicality of the computational data obtained are thoroughly evaluated. The primary conclusions are formulated, and the hypothesis that each brain channel exhibits distinct waves characteristic of specific brain regions is validated.

articleTitle: Advancing Quality Metrics in Statistical Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 16th International Conference Management of large-scale system development (MLSD)
abstract: A methodology is proposed for assessing the quality of a data set using the finite difference method. Corresponding measures, assessment models, and reference values are defined for the proposed quality characteristics. The proposed methodology has been applied to analyze statistical data characterizing the mortality rates of the populations in Russia, the United Kingdom, Sweden, and Japan for 2013-2020.
